text.aria-label: Title text 'Across-day attention of the target row, case clear day'

g.text: Across-day attention of the target row, case clear day

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each cell: the weight from the target row's token (x: its half-hour) to the history row (y: slot 1 is the nearest history row; for M* and E slot k is the row k+1 days old, for P the slots hold placebo rows 16 to 379 days old). Mean over 4 heads, last block. The weight left over falls on the target row itself, which is not drawn.'
text.tspan: Each cell: the weight from the target row's token (x: its half-hour) to the history row (y: slot 1
is the nearest history row; for M* and E slot k is the row k+1 days old, for P the slots hold
placebo rows 16 to 379 days old). Mean over 4 heads, last block. The weight left over falls on the
target row itself, which is not drawn.
